title: AION 2 Macro Guide: Keybind and Skill Priority
description: Create one working macro: bindings, chain priority and class conditions.
summary: Set the macro key, arrange skill priority and keep class reactions on separate buttons.
quickAnswer: Bind the ability-macro key under Key Settings → General → Gameplay, select the whole hotbar chain and hold the key. The bottom skill has priority; place filler above conditional attacks. Keep healing, movement and interrupts on direct keys.
